dialogues.speaker: 頼子
dialogues.jp: 「行ってらっしゃいませ……」
dialogues.en: Choice 1: I will give up on buying lunch today.
dialogues.text: Choice 1: I will give up on buying lunch today.

dialogues.speaker: 頼子
dialogues.jp: 「行ってきます」
dialogues.en: Choice 2: I will borrow money from someone.
dialogues.text: Choice 2: I will borrow money from someone.

dialogues.speaker: 頼子
dialogues.jp:
「行ってらっしゃいませ……か。一生のうちで、
　まさか、自分にそんな言葉が、かけられるな
　んてな」
dialogues.en: Choice 3: I will go back home to get my wallet.
dialogues.text: Choice 3: I will go back home to get my wallet.

dialogues.speaker: 頼子
dialogues.en:
Choice 4: A surprisingly cute girl will confess that she
likes me and give me a homemade lunch.
dialogues.text:
Choice 4: A surprisingly cute girl will confess that she
likes me and give me a homemade lunch.

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと桜に目を遣りながら歩いていると、
ふと、財布を忘れている事に気が付いた。
dialogues.en:
"I can't do choice 1, so it will be either choice 2, 3, or
4..."
dialogues.text:
"I can't do choice 1, so it will be either choice 2, 3, or
4..."

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ」
dialogues.en:
I turn around. I'm not too far from my house yet. And since
I woke up on time, I still have time to go back.
dialogues.text:
I turn around. I'm not too far from my house yet. And since
I woke up on time, I still have time to go back.

dialogues.jp: その１：昼飯は我慢する
dialogues.en:
I run back home along the cherry-tree-lined road,
maneuvering through the students walking towards school.
dialogues.text:
I run back home along the cherry-tree-lined road,
maneuvering through the students walking towards school.

dialogues.jp: その２：誰かから金を借りる
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.jp: その３：家に取りに戻る
dialogues.en: I open the door and run upstairs.
dialogues.text: I open the door and run upstairs.

dialogues.jp:
その４：何と！　可愛い女の子が告白と共にお
　　　　手製のお弁当をくれる
dialogues.en: I grab my wallet from a table and put it in my pocket.
dialogues.text: I grab my wallet from a table and put it in my pocket.

dialogues.jp: 「１は論外として、２か３か４か……」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
振り返る。幸い、それほど家から離れてはいな
い。目覚まし通りに起きたから、珍しく時間の
余裕もある。
dialogues.en:
It's when I'm coming down the stairs that I hear a crying
voice, between the sounds of my loud footsteps.
dialogues.text:
It's when I'm coming down the stairs that I hear a crying
voice, between the sounds of my loud footsteps.

dialogues.jp:
桜の舞い散る並木道を、学生の間を縫うように
して走り出した。
dialogues.en: (What is it......?)
dialogues.text: (What is it......?)

dialogues.jp: 「ただいまっと」
dialogues.en: I stop and listen.
dialogues.text: I stop and listen.

dialogues.jp: 玄関に飛び込むと、どたどたと階段を上がる。
dialogues.en:
(Is it the TV? But it didn't come from the living
room......)
dialogues.text:
(Is it the TV? But it didn't come from the living
room......)

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上に乗っていた財布を、ズボンのポ
ケットにねじ込む。
dialogues.en: The house is quiet and there's no crying voice any more.
dialogues.text: The house is quiet and there's no crying voice any more.

dialogues.en: (A break-in?)
dialogues.text: (A break-in?)

dialogues.jp:
階段を下りている時だった。騒々しい足音の合
間から、“ひえ〜ん”というような、悲痛な｛うめ／呻｝
きが聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: I feel like the air's suddenly sucked away from me.
dialogues.text: I feel like the air's suddenly sucked away from me.

dialogues.en:
My heart beats fast as I slowly move my feet into the living
room.
dialogues.text:
My heart beats fast as I slowly move my feet into the living
room.

dialogues.jp: ぴたりと立ち止まり、耳を澄ます。
dialogues.en: "There's nobody here...... Yoriko-san? Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text: "There's nobody here...... Yoriko-san? Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.jp:
（テレビ？　けど、居間から聞こえたんじゃな
　いような……）
dialogues.en: "Yes...... What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp:
家の中はしんとしていて、もう、あの声は聞こ
えてこない。
dialogues.en: "Wow. ......Wh-Why... are you all wet?"
dialogues.text: "Wow. ......Wh-Why... are you all wet?"

dialogues.jp: （まさか……強盗とか？）
dialogues.en:
She's all wet, from her stomach to her skirt, and the color
of the wet part on her clothes is darkened by water.
dialogues.text:
She's all wet, from her stomach to her skirt, and the color
of the wet part on her clothes is darkened by water.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい……。あの、どうなさったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, this... this is...... oh, no."
dialogues.text: "Oh, this... this is...... oh, no."

dialogues.jp:
お腹からスカートにかけて水で濡れていて、色
が濃くなってしまっている。
dialogues.en: "Ah, w-wait......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, w-wait......"

dialogues.jp:
来た時と同じ唐突さで、彼女は部屋を出ていっ
てしまった。
dialogues.en: She suddenly runs out of the living room.
dialogues.text: She suddenly runs out of the living room.

dialogues.jp:
何だか分からないが、ともかくその後を追う。
取り敢えず、強盗ではないらしいが……。
dialogues.en:
I have no idea what's going on but I just follow her. At
least it seems like it wasn't a break-in.
dialogues.text:
I have no idea what's going on but I just follow her. At
least it seems like it wasn't a break-in.

dialogues.jp:
廊下の濡れた足跡を追っていくと、たどりつい
たのは洗面所だった。
dialogues.en:
I follow the wet steps on the floor, and the last one ends
at the bathroom.
dialogues.text:
I follow the wet steps on the floor, and the last one ends
at the bathroom.

dialogues.jp: 「うおっ」
dialogues.en: "Wow!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉さん……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Junichi-san......"

dialogues.jp:
情けない顔を向ける頼子さんの向こうに、ごう
ごうと泡を吹く洗濯機の姿が……。
dialogues.en:
She looks helpless next to a washing machine that's blowing
out bubbles.
dialogues.text:
She looks helpless next to a washing machine that's blowing
out bubbles.

dialogues.en: "......A big crab?"
dialogues.text: "......A big crab?"

dialogues.jp:
などとギャグを言ってみるが、当然ながら事態
は好転しない。
dialogues.en:
It's a joke, but it's not helping the situation at all, of
course.
dialogues.text:
It's a joke, but it's not helping the situation at all, of
course.

dialogues.jp: 「てか、とりあえず脱水だっ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, we have to turn on the spin dry."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, we have to turn on the spin dry."

dialogues.jp: 勇ましく洗濯機に駆け寄り──
dialogues.en: I bravely run to the washing machine ----
dialogues.text: I bravely run to the washing machine ----

dialogues.jp: ゴチンッ！
dialogues.en: Thunk!
dialogues.text: Thunk!

dialogues.jp: 洗剤でヌルまっている床にすっころんだ……。
dialogues.en: I fall over onto the floor that's slippery with detergent.
dialogues.text: I fall over onto the floor that's slippery with detergent.

dialogues.jp: 「いちち……」
たんこぶを押さえつつ｛うめ／呻｝く。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on the bump.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on the bump.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「す、すみませんでした……」
dialogues.en: "I- I am so sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I- I am so sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
ぺこんと、頭とネコ耳を下げる頼子さん。服が
濡れてしまっているので、今は俺の服を身に着
けている。
dialogues.en:
She bends her head and cat ears down. She's wearing my
clothes because hers are all wet.
dialogues.text:
She bends her head and cat ears down. She's wearing my
clothes because hers are all wet.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……大丈夫、ですか？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you all right?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you all right?"

dialogues.jp:
下げた頭の向こうから、見上げるように顔を窺っ
てくる。
dialogues.en: She keeps her head bent down and looks into my face.
dialogues.text: She keeps her head bent down and looks into my face.

dialogues.jp:
「ああ、へーきへーき。ちょろっとぶっつけた
　だけだし」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm fine. I just hit my head lightly."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm fine. I just hit my head lightly."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「けれど、あの……」

言いにくそうにもじもじしつつ、頼子さんは言っ
た。
dialogues.en: She says hesitantly,
dialogues.text: She says hesitantly,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「凄かった、です。その……一回転して……」
dialogues.en: "But you turned upside down in the air......"
dialogues.text: "But you turned upside down in the air......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……げ。うそ？　マジで？　……それは見て
　みたかったかも」
dialogues.en:
"......You're kidding... Really? ......I kind of wish I
could see myself do that."
dialogues.text:
"......You're kidding... Really? ......I kind of wish I
could see myself do that."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの、やっぱりお医者様を……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I think we should get you a doctor......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I think we should get you a doctor......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、それは大げさだって」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't need a doctor."
dialogues.text: "No, I don't need a doctor."

dialogues.jp: 苦笑しつつ手を振る。
dialogues.en: I force a smile.
dialogues.text: I force a smile.

dialogues.jp:
目の前の心配顔が医者のそれに取って代わられ
るのは、どうも面白くない。
dialogues.en:
I would rather see the worried look on her face than the one
of a doctor.
dialogues.text:
I would rather see the worried look on her face than the one
of a doctor.

dialogues.jp:
「とは言え、いつまでも見ていられないしな
　……」
dialogues.en: "But I can't stay watching her either......"
dialogues.text: "But I can't stay watching her either......"

dialogues.jp:
時計に目を｛や／遣｝る。もはや、とっくに授業は始まっ
ている。
dialogues.en: I look at my watch. School's already started.
dialogues.text: I look at my watch. School's already started.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「見るって、あの……何をですか？」
dialogues.en: "You can't stay watching... what?"
dialogues.text: "You can't stay watching... what?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、こっちの話です」
dialogues.en: "No, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp:
どうせ授業が始まっているなら、２時限目に時
間を合わせた方が何かといいだろう。
dialogues.en:
The first class has already started. I should go for the
second class than sneaking in the middle of the first class.
dialogues.text:
The first class has already started. I should go for the
second class than sneaking in the middle of the first class.

dialogues.jp:
そんな訳で、これからの２、３０分ですべき事
を、俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
So I use the 2-30 minutes I have left to tell her what
should be done.
dialogues.text:
So I use the 2-30 minutes I have left to tell her what
should be done.

dialogues.jp:
「そんじゃ、洗濯機と洗剤の関係をレクチャー
　しましょうかね」
dialogues.en:
"Okay then, I'll teach you how to use the washing machine
and the detergent."
dialogues.text:
"Okay then, I'll teach you how to use the washing machine
and the detergent."

dialogues.jp: ◆洗濯◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yoriko◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yoriko◆

dialogues.jp:
財布を忘れて家に引き返した俺は、びしょ濡れ
で慌てる頼子さんと会う。
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
不思議に思い、後を追っていくとそこは洗面所、
ごうごうと洗濯機が泡を吐いていた。
dialogues.en:
"'I hope you have a nice day', huh? I never thought someone
would ever say that to me so sincerely like that."
dialogues.text:
"'I hope you have a nice day', huh? I never thought someone
would ever say that to me so sincerely like that."

dialogues.jp:
なんとかしようとスイッチに手を伸ばした俺だ
が、洗剤だらけの床にすべり、したたかに頭を
打ち付けてしまった。

騒ぎが一段落した頃には、授業は既に始まって
いた。
dialogues.en:
I'm looking vacantly at cherry blossoms on the way to the
school, when I realize I've forgotten my wallet.
dialogues.text:
I'm looking vacantly at cherry blossoms on the way to the
school, when I realize I've forgotten my wallet.

dialogues.jp:
取りあえず俺は、頼子さんに洗濯機と洗剤の使
い方をレクチャーしたのだった。
dialogues.en: "Hmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmm."
